approvers: My wife, my tax adviser and lawyer, and my house bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. I have 14 people who depend on me and I will not hand them to an offshore company I cannot check.
objection: Belize, no track record, no money committed. If the funding fails or they flip it or strip it, my staff and my name pay for it, and 30% over three years is paid by a company I cannot hold to account.
instead: Keep running the business and look for a successor or a known strategic or local buyer through my adviser, or list it anonymously on nexxt-change.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU-based buyer with committed, verified funds, named references from earlier acquisitions, bank-secured deferred payments and written staff and site guarantees, vetted by my adviser, and someone I can meet and trust.
